event: On a Tuesday, stirring indigo at the north vat, Essany Cord sees the colour has gone wrong.
Not the pigment: the blue is less present, pulled back from its own surface.
The yellow-grey wall has withdrawn the same way, a description of itself.
Three days later her physician tells her about the lungs: six weeks, eight if she rests.
She mixes her best indigo ever, to learn whether the wrongness is in the pigment or her eyes.
It is in her eyes.
A fabric merchant brings the rumour: a hole in a ridge a hundred miles north that kills.
A carter's apprentice adds that people go in and do not come out, and the place keeps a ledger.
Six days after the physician, the pull comes on a Thursday: your death can mean something else.
She packs that afternoon and leaves her sister Maret a note.
It says: I am going north. It is not the lungs. I will not be long.
She walks the forty-seven miles north in three days, as far as her lungs allow.
The camp is a settlement becoming itself: a tended fire, a ledger, a cloth, dear rope.
She sits by the fire; fire does not retreat from its own surface. Fire commits.
"Essany Cord," she says, before the ledger-keeper asks.
Asked if she is voluntary, she says yes, unsure it is accurate.
He does not ask about the cough.
Her purpose: to die in about five weeks, somewhere that is not a bed.
She goes in the next morning.
The Gullet is red-brown, ochre at the ribs, umber between, against a blue-green glow.
Two colours argue and are both right; this colour is not retreating.
She coughs, and keeps walking.
She reads the inscriptions and pauses at LIRA — FIRST COMPELLED, thinking of the pull.
She touches the blank gap: absence has its own colour, like gesso.
Twelve names and one gap, through Maret Dunn; she will be the fourteenth.
The dungeon is building a vocabulary of what people do when they come here to die.
She wonders what her word will be, and her cough echoes back folded like a dye bath.
Sixty meters on, where the blue-green glow saturates, the Asking comes like a dye taking.
I want to die on my terms: not to live, but to pick.
The Ledger names her The Brand, with the Gift Indelible Mark: touched surfaces show their flaws.
Its Cost is Reciprocity: each surface she marks marks her back with her own weaknesses.
The Ledger reads Vitality 6, Resolve 13, Attunement 9, Fortune 11.
Compelled from 47 miles: The entrant believes she chose. The Maw notes this without correction.
A good dye feels like the fabric's own colour; she decides it does not matter.
She picks up the glass bead; its green thread is verdigris, a colour you wait for.
She sets it back and turns it slightly, to show she has seen it, the green still out.
The arch is the cleanest stonework she has seen outside a cathedral.
This man built something that outlasts him; her colours always fade.
Stepping off, she touches the far abutment, and dark fine marks show it almost flawless.

changes.note: First Indelible Mark, on the arch abutment, Attunement +1

event: A mark appears on her right hand: thinning tendon, overworked joint, early calcium loss.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 14.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Warrens open like cloth unrolled too fast, cool and wet, tasting of limestone.
She counts six full breaths before the catch now; at the camp it was eight.
She chooses north, following the blue mineral traces deeper.
She reads the journal's first and last pages: To whoever reads this.
She touches the cover, and marks show its weak spine, thin corner, and stressed front.

changes.note: Second Indelible Mark, on the journal cover, Attunement +1

event: A mark on her left forearm maps her thinning veins like rivers.
She puts the journal back and goes north.
The Still Garden is the most beautiful place she has ever been.
The crystals break the light into violets, blues and golds she never managed in pigment.
The Ledger: Depth 3, Resolve +1, now 15.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: By the eastern wall she lifts the spear, too heavy, but something that pushes back.
She marks its shaft: an uneven grain, a deep knot, a head binding gone loose.

changes.note: Third Indelible Mark, on the spear shaft, Attunement +1

event: A deeper mark on her right shoulder shows weakening ribs and lung grown to the chest wall.
The Brand's honest count: four weeks, perhaps; the disease is ahead of schedule.
She puts the spear back: she does not expect to survive the fight, only to mark it.
At the far end of the third row lies The Patient, showing itself honestly.
She does not try to keep it in the corner of her eye; she looks straight at it.
She walks toward it as the crystals grow taller and closer.
She touches a crystal growth in passing, and marks show its layers and fracture angles.

changes.note: Fourth Indelible Mark, on a crystal growth, Attunement +1

event: A mark above her left breast maps how her lung will fail.
The Patient repositions: three rows closer, fifteen meters, turned to face her.
She is not trying to beat its mechanism, only to reach it before it reaches her.
She touches the floor, and marks show the solid paths and the voids beneath the crystals.

changes.note: Fifth Indelible Mark, on the floor paths, Attunement +1

event: A fifth mark, on her left hip: her pelvis losing density fastest.
She walks the solid path; The Patient is ten meters away.
Close up its shell has layers like built-up pigment, one that makes the eye slide away.
She does not let her eye slide away.
She takes one more step and touches The Patient's flank.

changes.note: Sixth Indelible Mark, on The Patient's shell, Attunement +1

event: The Gift burns out of her palm in thick dark strokes across its shell, finding every flaw.
A seam on the left flank where two growth layers never fused.
A nerve node at its anchor that coordinates its moves in the saccade gap.
A dorsal dome perfect outside and hollow within, one hard blow from cracking.
The marks are permanent; anyone who comes after will see where The Patient can be hurt.
The Patient strikes with all the force of its long stillness, and she is on the floor.
The last reciprocal mark spreads down her back: every way Essany Cord was breaking.
Looking at the crystals, she thinks: the violet, red held at the base. I see how it works.
She dies looking at the colour, not at The Patient.

changes.note: Essany is killed by The Patient, Vitality 6 to 0

event: The death report: Essany Cord, the Brand, Depth 3; six marks given, six received.
She is the first to touch The Patient and live long enough for a Gift to act: 1.3 seconds.
No Memory Crystal: her last state was seeing, not feeling.
The Floor Mutation: The Patient's shell, its first outside modification in 342 years.
Brand complete, Compelled at 47 miles; whether she chose is not the Ledger's to say.
The Ledger finds it wrote, for the first time, of its own choice not to correct.
This is the Mirror's Reflection, absorbed: the Maw now watches itself.
The Patient settles, unable to see its marks but feeling that something has changed.
Its kill count is five, and the fifth is the first to have marked it.
At camp the ledger-keeper writes Essany Cord, and leaves the voluntary column blank.
A passer-by has written on the cloth: the dyer went in coughing. she was already dead.
The fire still burns, and the tally turns: 986 remain.
ESSANY CORD — DEPTH 3 — FIRST TO LEAVE A MARK.
